sccache.description: Root object for sccache configuration parameters.

sccache.config.description: General configuration settings for the sccache instance.

sccache.config.client_side_mode.description: Enable client-side mode to perform cache lookups locally instead of sending them to the server.

sccache.config.cache_dir.description: The local filesystem path where cache data is stored when no remote backend is used or for tiered caching.

sccache.backends.s3.enabled.description: Whether to enable the S3 backend.

sccache.backends.s3.bucket.description: The name of the S3 bucket to use for caching.

sccache.backends.s3.region.description: The AWS region of the S3 bucket.

sccache.backends.s3.access_key.description: The AWS access key ID for authentication.

sccache.backends.s3.secret_access_key.description: The AWS secret access key for authentication.

sccache.backends.s3.use_sse_kms.description: Enable Server-Side Encryption with AWS KMS keys.

sccache.backends.s3.kms_key_id.description: The ARN or ID of the KMS key to use for encryption.

sccache.backends.s3.readonly.description: If true, this backend only serves cache hits and does not write new entries.

sccache.backends.redis.enabled.description: Whether to enable the Redis backend.

sccache.backends.redis.url.description: The connection URL for the Redis instance.

sccache.backends.redis.password.description: The password for authenticating with Redis.

sccache.backends.redis.readonly.description: If true, this backend only serves cache hits and does not write new entries.

sccache.distributed.server_addr.description: The address of the sccache distribution server.

sccache.distributed.auth_key.description: The shared secret key for authenticating with the distribution server.

sccache.distributed.tls.description: Enable TLS for communication with the distribution server.

sccache.distributed.ca_cert.description: Path to the CA certificate file for verifying the server's certificate.

sccache.distributed.client_cert.description: Path to the client certificate for mutual TLS authentication.

sccache.distributed.client_key.description: Path to the client private key for mutual TLS authentication.

sccache.environment.compiler_env_vars.description: List of environment variable names to pass through to the compiler when invoked by sccache.
